instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope feels handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture (soft matte, subtle fibers, delicate pearlescent finish), elegant folds and precise geometry. The design uses a romantic color palette of soft pink and white, accented with light green and elegant gold details, creating a harmonious and sophisticated look. Fine ornamental closure with wax seal, ribbon, embossed floral emblem or gilded botanical accents, all highly tactile and meticulously detailed.

The envelope is placed within an enchanted garden environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a magical narrative scene with lush flowers, delicate leaves, climbing vines, glowing petals and a dreamy fairytale atmosphere. The garden feels alive and immersive, with softly blurred but visually recognizable botanical elements, creating depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including floating blossoms, tiny butterflies, sparkling dust, luminous pollen and gentle light particles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, floating softly and enhancing motion and enchantment without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light rays filtering through the enchanted garden. Gentle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, magical and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, inspired by luxury invitations and fantasy editorial photography — pastel pinks, clean whites, fresh light greens and refined gold highlights — with smooth gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations and storytelling visuals.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
The animation begins by focusing on an envelope sealed with a single wax seal. A delicate butterfly gently flutters into frame, gracefully flying toward the envelope. It lands softly on the wax seal, resting momentarily with its wings slowly opening and closing. The butterfly's arrival triggers the seal to physically detach and fall to the ground — it is not replaced, duplicated, or regenerated at any point. The envelope remains permanently open after this moment, without any additional seal appearing.
Once the seal is removed, the envelope flap slowly lifts. From within, shimmering sparkles, glittering dust, and trails of radiant light emerge, spreading in a mesmerizing display to the surroundings, with magical beams of luminous particles curving around the envelope, passing in front of and behind it in a three-dimensional spiral. These particles originate only from inside the envelope and also from behind the envelope, increasing in density and brightness as they move.
The radiant light intensifies and expands outward, gradually filling the entire scene. No new physical objects are introduced during this transition. The intense glow of the beams and sparkles transforms into a solid, dazzling white screen in the final frame. The camera subtly and slowly zooms in.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
aberturaSlide4Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
